// diagnostic E0086

Jet.AmbiguousMarker

This qualified marker has more than one declaring module.

What

This qualified marker has more than one declaring module.

Why

A marker's import path must resolve to one module and one exported row.

Fix

Give the modules distinct import aliases and qualify the marker with one of them.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.AmbiguousMarker: Tests/UI/QualifiedMarkerAliasAmbiguous/stderr.

    |  ^^^^^^^
 Why: A marker's import path must resolve to one module and one exported row
 Fix: Give the modules distinct import aliases and qualify the marker with one of them
